fingerprint.bandicam: 8.3.0.2533 GDI Nvidia NVENC (encoder tag of the file)
fingerprint.fps: variable, 30 nominal; 12978 video frames in 662.50 s

interventions.what: Bandicam window capture of the Isle Wars Pro game window; the owner played one game from the options screen to the end screen (11:02 recording). The video file is the only output. No scripted clicks. Counters, seats and screens were read from pixels by region comparison and template matching of glyph shapes, with no OCR pass.

start_state.restore: Owner launched a new game on the unregistered Pro build from the options screen (seat 1 human, three computer seats, middle strength). Pro has no save file (C-SET-05), so no state was restored. The recording starts on the title screen; the opening deal is the first board.

args: probe: 662.50 s, 12978 video frames, variable frame rate (nominal 30), 1920x1080 H.264, AAC 48 kHz stereo, 87585120 bytes
ffmpeg 8.0.1; the panel regions were read frame by frame from the container timestamps; offsets are mm:ss.mmm video offsets
record content: the 46 turn starts of the game, army pools, card counts, card draws and trade-ins

observations.field: reading method
observations.value: the scoreboard (top left: four rows with territory count and card count, a marker on the seat whose turn it is) read at every frame where it changed, by matching glyph shapes of its digits (no OCR); a turn starts when the marker moves to the seat; the placement message (the seat, its number of islands, the armies to place) read for the number of armies to place (the digits before the word for armies). Card counts at a turn start are read at the first frame of the marker, so a trade-in made a few seconds into the turn is not yet in them.

observations.field: seat order and the first seat
observations.value: the playing seat followed blue (the human), yellow, red, green in that order for all 46 turns before the human seat was out (11 full rounds and 2 more turns); the first seat to play was the human seat. In the earlier owner sitting (IP1 026) the first seat to play was yellow.

observations.field: human card draws, read from the card screen at the end of the turn
observations.value: six draws, one per capturing human turn: the doubling card (turn 9, 02:29; hand of 1), a second doubling card (turn 13, 03:39; hand of 2), the empty-the-hand card (turn 25, drawn at 05:44.2 with two doubling cards in hand; the hand is empty at 05:46.0), the bomb card (turn 33, 07:31), the +5 card (turn 37, 08:23; hand: bomb and +5) and the wildcard (turn 45, 10:28; hand: bomb, +5, wildcard)

observations.field: the owner opens the card view with an empty hand
observations.value: in turn 9, at 02:24.6 the owner pressed the card button on the action bar with no card in hand: a card screen with five empty slots and a continue button showed until 02:25.4, then the action bar came back; the count stayed 0 (the first card came at 02:30.6)

observations.field: computer trade-ins (all four took three cards from the hand)
observations.value: green turn 16: cards 3 to 0 at 04:01.1, message naming 5 extra armies, pool 6 became 11 (04:03.5), then a capture draw 0 to 1 at 04:06.1; yellow turn 26: 5 to 2 at 05:49.8, message for doubling the army total, pool 4 became 8 (05:52.1), no capture that turn; red turn 43: 5 to 2 at 09:34.0, message naming 8 extra armies, then a capture draw 2 to 3 at 09:41.1; green turn 44: 4 to 1 at 09:45.1, message for bombing a country (09:46.0 to 09:52.5), pool 12 unchanged at 09:56.5 (it was 12 before)

observations.field: the bomb match of green turn 44 and the notice that followed
observations.value: the bomb message ran from 09:46.0 to 09:52.5; at 09:53.4 a notice said the defending country had protection (09:53.4 to 09:55.9); the only other hand to change was the yellow seat, 5 to 4 at 09:55.967; the army pool for green stayed 12 (message at 09:56.5)

observations.field: draws that emptied a hand
observations.value: three draws emptied the hand: the green seat at turn 24 (2 to 0 at 05:24.4, with a capture that turn and no trade-in), the human seat at turn 25 (2 to 0 at 05:46.3, the empty-the-hand card seen on the card screen) and the green seat at turn 44 (1 to 0 at 10:01.6, after the bomb trade-in and a capture)

observations.field: full hand
observations.value: the yellow seat held 5 cards from 05:10.1 (turn 22) and drew no sixth: at turn 42 it captured three times with 5 cards and had 5 at the next turn start (09:31.3); no discard prompt was seen for the computer

observations.field: the elimination of the human seat and the cards
observations.value: at 10:42.867 the human seat reached 0 countries with 3 cards in hand; at 10:42.900 its hand showed 0 and the yellow seat (the capturing seat, 4 cards) showed 5, not 7 (the hand limit)

observations.field: armies to place against territory count, human turns (no island named at turns 1, 37, 41 and 45 by eye)
observations.value: turn (count, pool): 1 (9, 3), 5 (8, 2), 9 (8, 2), 13 (9, 3), 17 (10, 3), 21 (8, 2), 25 (7, 2), 29 (7, 2), 33 (6, 2), 37 (5, 2), 41 (3, 2), 45 (2, 2); each equals the count divided by 3 rounded down, raised to 2, with no island bonus; counts are those at the turn start frame
